how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-tanaris-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:10:obj:0: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:10:details:0: Oh, this is just terrible! I sent out my top assistant, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, into the desert southeast of here. That's an area we call the Gaping Chasm. Well, he's gone missing, and his last report had more of those weird bugs where he was. Could it be that they've infested two major regions of the desert now?
rows.quest:10:details:1: BI need you to head into the Gaping Chasm and look for Scrimshank, please! That... or at least find his surveying equipment. I fear that may be all that is left of the poor sod.
rows.quest:10:completion:0: He was a good goblin, young Scrimshank. Let's hope that his demise was not in vain by what he was able to record with his surveying equipment.
rows.quest:10:completion:1: BIt seems as though we have quite the situation on our hands here with these bugs. They're way too cunning for their own good, and the research we've done so far is shaping up to indicate that they might even be under the controlling influence of a third party! If this is the case, then it bodes ill for not only Gadgetzan, but the whole desert!
rows.quest:32:obj:0: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:32:details:0: Here's your report. I urge you to take it to someone who might have working knowledge in this kind of thing.
rows.quest:32:details:1: BI know this troll scholar named Zilzibin Drumlore. He's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of ⟦E2⟧; he's a historian to boot! If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is and how to stop it, give this report to him. We're going to need all the help we can get.
rows.quest:32:details:2: BZil lives in a house on the second tier of the Drag in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:32:completion:0: This report... I've dealt with these beasts before. Fizzledowser was wise to send this. and you, to me.
rows.quest:32:completion:1: BThese creatures will consume the ⟦E3⟧ desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. Familiarize yourself with this name, ⟦1⟧: silithid. The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the ⟦E4⟧ and ⟦E5⟧ face.
rows.quest:32:completion:2: BIf only we were smart enough to see that before.
rows.quest:82:obj:0: Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:82:details:0: All right now, these reports about the bugs... what we know is that they are draining the water pools that used to be where the Noxious Lair is. What we DON'T know is, well, everything else.
rows.quest:82:details:1: BLet's figure out who our enemy is first! I want you to head into the Noxious Lair and get some parts off of those critters. Get five from the Centipaar there and bring them to Alchemist Pestlezugg for him to dink with. With him on the case, we'll figure out what they are!
rows.quest:82:completion:0: Good work - I'll start my analysis on these now! I can tell you right from the start though... these are nothing like any insect form I have ever seen. It's almost as if these bugs are being controlled by an outside force or something.
rows.quest:82:completion:1: BYou need to go talk to Fizzledowser right away; apparently there is an emergency that he needs your help with on the double! I'm not sure, but I think it involves more of the bugs in the ⟦E3⟧ desert!
rows.quest:110:obj:0: Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.
rows.quest:110:details:0: I'm going to spend some time taking a look at Scrimshank's surveying gear... as well as putting his personal effects in order. I get the sneaking feeling behind my ears that this isn't the last loss we'll be facing against these bugs.
rows.quest:110:details:1: BI'd like for you to check in with Alchemist Pestlezugg to see if he has had a chance to process the insect parts we sent him. If they're ready, bring them to me.
rows.quest:110:completion:0: Yes, I have the results right here. They are... unsettling, to say the least
rows.quest:110:completion:1: BOur initial suspicion that the bugs are being controlled by an outside force, we believe, is correct. If this is the case, then we are dealing with not only a very powerful unknown force, but also a malignant one. These bugs have been changed to be pure ravagers. I've never seen anything quite like it.
rows.quest:113:obj:0: Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan. Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.
rows.quest:113:details:0: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser needs to see this report immediately. Actually... everyone who can read needs to see this report. We are facing a grave and serious threat to not only ⟦E3⟧ and Gadgetzan, but if left unchecked, the entirety of southern ⟦E6⟧. Heck, even quite possible the whole of ⟦E2⟧; this thing has given no indication it will subside.
rows.quest:113:details:1: BHave Fizzledowser make a duplicate of the report for you to distribute freely to your allegiance. Everyone must know about this threat!
rows.quest:113:completion:0: Thank you for delivering the report, Junior Surveyor ⟦2⟧; here is your pay for your diligent service to the Gadgetzan Water Company.
rows.quest:113:completion:1: BWhile I am usually not thrilled about handing out our valuable information carte blanche to those who would otherwise pay good coin for it, I've known Pestlezugg for a number of years now. If he recommends letting everyone know about it, then so be it. Give me a moment and I'll make you a copy.
rows.quest:162:obj:0: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:162:details:0: I urge you to take this report to someone who has working knowledge in this kind of thing.
rows.quest:162:details:1: BI know this night elf scholar named Gracina Spiritmight. She's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of ⟦E2⟧; she's a historian to boot! If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is, and more importantly how to stop it, give her the report. We'll need the help.
rows.quest:162:details:2: BLast I heard, she was residing in the Temple of the Moon, located in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:162:completion:0: This report... we night elves know of the terror mentioned here. Fizzledowser was wise to send this, and you, to me.
rows.quest:162:completion:1: BThese creatures will consume the ⟦E3⟧ desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. Familiarize yourself with this name, ⟦3⟧: silithid. The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the ⟦E4⟧ and ⟦E5⟧ face.
rows.quest:162:completion:2: BIf only we were smart enough to see that before.
rows.quest:243:obj:0: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.
rows.quest:243:details:0: You will be headed to the ⟦E3⟧ desert, testing the tissue consistency of the basilisks, scorpids, and hyena native there. Obtain tissue samples and use them with the testing kit in tow; expect a chunk of the samples to fail. I need eight acceptable samples of each creature type.
rows.quest:243:details:1: BIn addition, the goblins of Gadgetzan have a power source that must be used with this kind of modified kit. Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle and acquire one for the kit.
rows.quest:243:details:2: BReturn to me only when you are successful.
rows.quest:243:completion:0: Ah, our model 4711-FTZ power sources! We normally use them to power the water wells, but THANKS TO THE VILE NOMADS, we have an over abundance of power sources right now.
rows.quest:243:completion:1: BSure, I can get you a power source for whatever nefarious science experiment you think you're trying to hide from me. It ain't gonna be free though, ⟦4⟧. Nothing's free in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:351:obj:0: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.
rows.quest:351:details:0: You have uncovered some sort of strange, egg-shaped device made from metal. Fiddling with one of its knobs springs the egg to life, as it opens up into some sort of gnomish robotic contraption! A voice from inside the robotic egg crackles to life.
rows.quest:351:details:1: B"The name's Oglethorpe, and my homing robot has gone missing! I will reward you for its recovery! Please take this beacon to the robot. Excellent, I now have computed the coordinates for you! It crashed near the Gaping Chasm in ⟦E3⟧!"
rows.quest:351:completion:0: You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.
rows.quest:351:completion:1: BHums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up. After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:
rows.quest:351:completion:2: B"OOX-17/TN is working at least, but it needs major repairs! It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea. Are you up for watching over it some more?"
rows.quest:379:obj:0: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:379:details:0: You want a power source. I can help you with that. Know what I want? I want something to drink! Bring me five Wastewander Water Pouches, and I'll give you the 4711-FTZ.
rows.quest:379:details:1: BNow... guess where you can find Wastewander Water Pouches! Why don't you walk up to one of the Wastewander nomads to the east of here and ask them for one. Let me know how that works out for you.
rows.quest:379:completion:0: Excellent, the power source is yours. Now, it isn't completely designed for use in a science kit like that, so you'll only have a limited amount of time before all the data you collect will go kablooey!
rows.quest:379:completion:1: BWhen you collect everything you need for whatever it is you are doing, bring it to me and I'll shut it down properly. You'll have at most two hours to get what you need to get done, done.
rows.quest:379:completion:2: BIf you don't get it done in time, I can always sell you another power source to try again. You heard me - sell!
rows.quest:648:obj:0: Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:648:details:0: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:
rows.quest:648:details:1: B"I need to move OOX-17/TN to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure. It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again. I need you to escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, Steamwheedle Port! That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things on line!"
rows.quest:648:details:2: B"Escort it safely to the port, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay! Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"
rows.quest:648:completion:0: Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-17/TN! I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! My homing robot series needs more developing, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in rebinding costs!
rows.quest:648:completion:1: BPlease, take your choice of any of these items I have. Hopefully, you will make good use of one of them. Thank you again for your generous assistance, my robots and I are in your debt!
rows.quest:654:obj:0: Acquire acceptable samples for 8 basilisks, 8 hyenas, and 8 scorpions. Bring the testing kit back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan before the power source runs out.
rows.quest:654:details:0: Activating the power source makes the field testing kit start to glow and vibrate. It would seem to be working as planned.
rows.quest:654:details:1: BAccording to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle, you now have two hours to collect the data you need in the ⟦E3⟧ desert. If you do not collect it within two hours, all the data will be lost and you will need to buy another power source from him.
rows.quest:654:details:2: BReturn to him when you have completed the task.
rows.quest:654:completion:0: All right then, it will take me just a second to remove the power source. After that, you can do with it whatever you like now without having to worry about losing the data inside.
rows.quest:992:obj:0: Use the untapped dowsing widget near the pool of water by Sandsorrow Watch. Once you have collected the sample, return the tapped dowsing widget to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:992:details:0: We've got a position open for a temporary junior-grade surveyor in the Gadgetzan Water Company, if you're interested!
rows.quest:992:details:1: BWith the nomads seizing all our wells, we need to exploit more free sources of water! There is water to be had in the desert, but only to those smart enough to survey them first.
rows.quest:992:details:2: BTake this dowsing widget and tap a sample of the water by the pool near Sandsorrow Watch. It's right in sight of the trolls around there. Bring the tapped widget back to me when you're done!
rows.quest:992:completion:0: What's this? You were ambushed by some sort of bad mojo creepy-crawly? Oh, this does not bode well for the Gadgetzan Water Company, no indeed...
rows.quest:992:completion:1: BI guess I should have told you about the reports coming in on some crazy bug-creatures that appear to be sucking up all the water in the desert. At first, I thought it was just a crock. We have enough trouble with the nomads as is; I thought it was just more of their shenanigans. Well, now we know at least!
rows.quest:1560:obj:0: Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
rows.quest:1560:details:1: BMy wife, Torta, sent me out to fetch dinner and I must have taken a wrong turn somewhere.
rows.quest:1560:details:2: BWould you be so kind as to lead me back to Torta? She's waiting for me just south of Steamwheedle Port.
rows.quest:1560:completion:0: So he couldn't find his way back on his own? Figures.
rows.quest:1560:completion:1: BWell, I guess you deserve something for your troubles....
rows.quest:1690:obj:0: Take down 10 Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of Gadgetzan, then report back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.
rows.quest:1690:details:0: You there! It's time for you to be a big helper to the Gadgetzan Water Company.
rows.quest:1690:details:1: BThe Wastewander nomads out in the ⟦E3⟧ desert have seized almost all the water wells! Without access to them, our water supply will dry up in no time. If you want to get in our good graces, then you'll help us bring justice to those nomads!
rows.quest:1690:details:2: BHead east of here and bring down ten Wastewander Bandits and Thieves, then report back to me on the double. Justice waits for no man... goblin... bah, just get on it!
rows.quest:1690:completion:0: Now that's what I call efficiency! You've helped thin out the nomad's numbers enough now that we can start to think about how we can win back those water wells.
rows.quest:1690:completion:1: BThe Gadgetzan Water Company thanks you for your help, but we're far from done in dealing with those foul nomads. Listen close - here's what we need next...
rows.quest:1691:obj:0: Take down 10 Wastewander Shadow Mages, 8 Wastewander Rogues, and 6 Wastewander Assassins for Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.⟦5⟧
rows.quest:1691:details:0: We need you to take on the stronger ranks of the Wastewander nomads now. You've done a good job thus far, but if we are to take back those water wells, then it only makes sense to do it against as few nomads as possible!
rows.quest:1691:details:1: BThis time around we need you to take down their rogues, assassins, and shadow mages. You'll find them east and southeast of here.
rows.quest:1691:details:2: BI'm not going to lie to you - they're a nasty lot. Do this for us though, and we'll be on our way to taking back what is rightfully ours!
rows.quest:1691:completion:0: Top notch work, ⟦6⟧... top notch! You've thinned down the nomad population to a point where we can actually take the fight to them!
rows.quest:1691:completion:1: BIf you haven't already, talk to Spigot Operator Luglunket here; he gives a bounty on any of the Wastewander water pouches you may have run across while bringing those nomads to justice!
rows.quest:1707:obj:0: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:1707:details:0: Greetings ⟦7⟧ - the name's Luglunket, and we've got an important job for you if you're up for it! Huzzah!
rows.quest:1707:details:1: BNothing would please me more as a seasoned spigot operator to take any Wastewander water pouches you might find out in the desert. That's our water anyway - the nomads have just stolen it is all! The Gadgetzan Water Company will offer you an official care package for every five you turn in. Most importantly though, you're helping Gadgetzan help itself!
rows.quest:1707:completion:0: Excellent - the more water pouches we are able to reclaim, the further away from disaster we'll all be! Keep 'em coming, and I will be sure to reward you for every five water pouches you bring me.
rows.quest:2605:obj:0: Collect a Laden Dew Gland and bring it to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:2605:details:0: I've got an idea, see. I've heard of some strange creatures called dew collectors that live to the southwest... and that they are able to store water in special glands.
rows.quest:2605:details:1: BI think that if I could get one of these glands, I could create a drink that would quench my terrible thirst! Do you think you could help me, ⟦8⟧?
rows.quest:2605:details:2: BLook for the cactus garden, ⟦9⟧; that's where you'll find the dew collectors.
rows.quest:2605:completion:0: Oh, wonderful! Give it here -- let me drink it!
rows.quest:2606:obj:0: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:2606:details:0: Blech! This stuff tastes terrible! So much for that idea...
rows.quest:2606:details:1: BWait, what's that? Oh, I know, I know, you think I shouldn't give up on this stuff. Well, okay then.
rows.quest:2606:details:2: BUhhhh, I have an idea! Brilliant! Take this dew to my friend Sprinkle -- she's an excellent chef. Tell her what we're up to here and that we want to make it go down a little easier.
rows.quest:2606:details:3: BI mean, if it's going to taste that bad, it at least should have some kick to it... And I'm just not feeling it...
rows.quest:2606:completion:0: Marin's a good guy, don't get me wrong -- just a little... eccentric, I'd say.
rows.quest:2606:completion:1: BAnd of course he needs my help, yet again.
rows.quest:2641:obj:0: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan wants you to collect a Violet Tragan and return it to her.
rows.quest:2641:details:0: When I was a kid, my sister used to do all the cooking. It was horrible! I could barely stomach some of her concoctions -- until I found what I like to call my "secret" ingredient! Add it to anything, and... WOW! It tastes great!
rows.quest:2641:details:1: BWhat is it, you ask? It's a mushroom called the Violet Tragan. If you want me to help you turn this horrid-tasting brew into something edible, head to the Hinterlands, and look for a small lake there.
rows.quest:2641:details:2: BOh, and remember, the Violet Tragan can only be found underwater.
rows.quest:2641:completion:1: BIt looks so good, I might just... Haha, gotcha!
rows.quest:2661:obj:0: Sprinkle wants to you take the Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:2661:details:0: Here's the Violet Powder, ⟦11⟧. Take it to Marin and tell him he owes me a favor!
rows.quest:2661:completion:0: Violet Powder, eh? Let's give it a try -- it sure couldn't make it any worse, that's for sure!
rows.quest:2662:obj:0: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak to him again after he creates his elixir.
rows.quest:2662:details:0: Now, to mix this powder in with the dew.
rows.quest:2662:details:1: BCome back and talk to me in a minute... after I have perfected the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!
rows.quest:2662:completion:1: BI knew I had it in me... Oh thanks again, ⟦12⟧ for your help, but please, stand a little to the side, will you? You're blocking my business! I'm going to make millions on the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir, millions!
rows.quest:2662:completion:2: BWhat's that? Sprinkle says I owe her a favor? Oh, that Sprinkle, such a kidder!
rows.quest:2741:completion:0: You place the hippogryph egg into the machine. A series of beeps follows along with some strange mechanical sounds.
rows.quest:2741:completion:1: BIt appears that the Eggometer has weighed, measured, and packaged your egg. Now that's speedy service!
rows.quest:2781:obj:0: Bring the head of Caliph Scorpidsting to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:2781:details:1: BThe Gadgetzan Water Company of Gadgetzan, ⟦E3⟧ will pay a high bounty for the head of Caliph Scorpidsting, leader of the Wastewander outlaws. His crimes include:
rows.quest:2781:details:2: B1. Murdering Gadgetzan Water Co. employees!⟦13⟧2.Stealing Gadgetzan Water Co. resources!⟦14⟧3.Seizing Gadgetzan Water Co. property!
rows.quest:2781:details:3: BBring proof of Caliph Scorpidsting's demise to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle for an immediate reward!
rows.quest:2781:completion:0: Finally - justice is served! You have struck a mighty blow against those vile nomads! With Scorpidsting's demise, this might be just the thing to finally push those squatters off of Gadgetzan's water wells!
rows.quest:2781:completion:1: BBy the authority of the Gadgetzan Water Company, I gladly award you with this bounty. You've done a great service for us all.
rows.quest:2872:obj:0: Speak with Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.
rows.quest:2872:details:0: My old buddy Stoley owes me a very special bottle of rum. He tends the bar at Steamwheedle Port in ⟦E3⟧, ⟦E6⟧, and he promised me that the rum there is stronger than anything we can find in Booty Bay. He's so confident that he says if I try that rum and don't agree with him, then he'll double the money he owes me!
rows.quest:2872:details:1: BWell, I think he's not as confident as he was when last we spoke, and now he's afraid to give me that rum. But I don't back down from wagers, so why don't you talk to him for me...
rows.quest:2872:completion:0: Ah, so you've been speaking with MacKinley, have you?
rows.quest:2872:completion:1: BIt's not what he thinks! I'm not afraid to give him some Steamwheedle Bilge Rum...
rows.quest:2872:completion:2: BI just don't have any rum to give him!
rows.quest:2873:obj:0: Bring Stoley's Shipment to Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.
rows.quest:2873:details:0: I owe "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay some rum, to settle a bet, but I'm all out of rum! Captain Cuergo stole my last shipment, and he has it stowed in that walled pirate town to the south.
rows.quest:2873:details:1: BIf you can find my shipment of rum and return it to me, then I can prove to MacKinley that ⟦E6⟧'s booze beats the dirt out of Booty Bay!
rows.quest:2873:completion:0: Great, thanks for the shipment! Now MacKinley and I can finally settle our wager.
rows.quest:2874:obj:0: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:2874:details:0: Thanks again for your help, ⟦15⟧. Here's a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum. Take it to MacKinley and he can finally put to rest his crazy beliefs about Booty Bay booze.
rows.quest:2874:completion:1: BI can't believe it! This stuff is... terrible! That's great!
rows.quest:2874:completion:2: BWell I guess Stoley can keep the money he owes me. He's true to his word about Steamwheedle bilge rum. That stuff is as thick as gravel and burns like lava!
rows.quest:2875:obj:0: Bring Andre's Head to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle in Steamwheedle Port.
rows.quest:2875:details:0: The vile pirate Andre Firebeard is wanted for crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:2875:details:1: BBy decree of governing counsel, any who read this are hereby authorized to use lethal force during the apprehension of Andre and his abettors.
rows.quest:2875:details:2: BBy further decree, should Andre be deceased, or otherwise indisposed, during the time of his hearing, his head may act as proxy, and deliverance of such head to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle constitutes a binding, and tenderable, contract.
rows.quest:2875:completion:0: Ah, Andre's head. So I guess he'll make his trial after all!
rows.quest:2875:completion:1: BMuch appreciated, ⟦16⟧. Now if you'll just sign here, I can issue you payment for services rendered.
rows.quest:2875:completion:2: BDon't worry about the small print. It's harmless, and... I don't think there's a magnifying glass small enough to read it anyway.
rows.quest:2876:obj:0: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.
rows.quest:2876:details:0: This scroll contains the schedules of shipments between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay. Both past and future shipments are included, along with ship names, with large 'X's next to some ships' journeys, and annotations like "GREAT LOOT" and "HARD FIGHT" next to others.
rows.quest:2876:details:1: BSomeone at Steamwheedle Port would want to see this document.
rows.quest:2876:completion:0: Oh my, this looks to be a list of ship departures and arrivals, with accurate dates and times and everything! If the captain of a pirate ship got his hands on this, he could have himself a field day!
rows.quest:2876:completion:1: BYou say you got this from a pirate? Well that's disturbing news...
rows.quest:2876:completion:2: BThank you, ⟦17⟧. I'm glad you took it from him, and I'm glad that pirate's eating dirt right now!
rows.quest:2954:obj:0: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the ⟦E3⟧ desert.
rows.quest:2954:details:0: "Salutations - I am a guardian of entry. Unless you have the Plates of Uldum already integrated with your disc set, I will not allow for entry into the Uldum compound."
rows.quest:2954:details:1: BThe appearance of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon must be the reaction that was hoped for in sending you out to the ⟦E3⟧ desert with the platinum discs. As instructed, you will need to find out what the story behind the Stone Watcher is before continuing on.
rows.quest:2954:completion:0: The stone watcher's voice resonates with power and authority:
rows.quest:2954:completion:1: B"Your discs will be returned to you once you access the pedestal. When you have obtained the Plates of Uldum and incorporated them into your existing disc set, you may then enter the complex."
rows.quest:3022:obj:0: Bring the Carefully-packed Crate to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
rows.quest:3022:details:0: ⟦18⟧, I can see you yearn to be dedicated to my worthwhile cause. Yes, of course, you can do something for me!
rows.quest:3022:details:1: BTake this crate of eggs to Erelas Ambersky. He is a druid that cares for these eggs, helping them to hatch and then training the young hippogryphs. You will find him in ⟦E8⟧, in a small village to the south called Rut'theran.
rows.quest:3022:completion:0: Thank you for your help, ⟦19⟧. The hippogryph population simply wouldn't flourish if it weren't for us. Ah, but I am sure you understand all too well, having traveled to ⟦E9⟧ yourself, and seen the devastation of the Gordunni there.
rows.quest:3022:completion:1: BWell, as you can see, I am hard at work here, so you'd best be on your way.
rows.quest:3161:obj:0: Marvon Rivetseeker in ⟦E3⟧ wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.
rows.quest:3161:details:0: ⟦21⟧, I'm a scientist, but also a treasure hunter at heart!
rows.quest:3161:details:1: BLong ago, when trolls used to occupy this land, they created large amounts of ornaments modeled after Gahz'rilla, a hydra they worshipped as a deity. These ornaments are carved out of an element that I call "Gahz'ridian", after the hydra god.
rows.quest:3161:details:2: BI did find some myself, but I'd like to have some more to study -- maybe you can find some?
rows.quest:3161:details:3: BI even invented a detector that makes finding the Gahz'ridian a snap! Just put it on, and the search begins!
rows.quest:3161:completion:0: Perfect; these ornaments are perfect for my studies. Thanks so much for the help, ⟦22⟧.
rows.quest:3161:completion:1: BOh, can I get my helmet back?
rows.quest:3362:obj:0: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.
rows.quest:3362:details:0: Have you ever seen Thistleshrub Valley? It's a mighty dangerous place, ⟦23⟧.
rows.quest:3362:details:1: BThose strange beasts there, I don't trust them for a minute! Gnarled thistleshrubs and thistleshrub rootshapers, that's what I think they were called...
rows.quest:3362:details:2: BAnyhow, I want to get into the valley, but with so many of those thistleshrubs around, there's no way I'm going back there. But here's where you come in -- if you clear some of them out, I just might think about going back. What do you think, ⟦24⟧? Help me out?
rows.quest:3362:completion:0: They're that big? I might have to rethink my plan...
rows.quest:3362:completion:1: BBut you did hold up your end of the bargain, so here's what I promised.
rows.quest:3444:obj:0: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.
rows.quest:3444:details:0: I once entered the foreboding chambers of the Sunken Temple. The evil in that place penetrates all that enter; I barely managed to find my way out, wading through the ooze that now covers the floors. All I can remember is stumbling through a large circular room, filled with serpent statues...
rows.quest:3444:details:1: BRecently, I discovered a round stone that appeared to have the same serpent symbol imprinted on it. I had it packed up and shipped to my workshop in Ratchet. Retrieve it, and I might be able to tell you more.
rows.quest:3444:completion:1: BIt's all coming back to me now, ⟦25⟧...
rows.quest:3520:obj:0: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in ⟦E9⟧, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.
rows.quest:3520:details:0: I seek the spirits of the vale screechers of ⟦E9⟧. They are the cousins of an old, old god, and their spirits are linked to him.
rows.quest:3520:details:1: BTake this bramble wand and go to ⟦E9⟧. Find and defeat vale screechers in southern and central ⟦E9⟧, then wave my bramble over their fallen bodies. This will coax their spirit to reveal itself. Touch the spirit and collect its essence.
rows.quest:3520:details:2: BReturn to me with my bramble and with the collected essence, and I will tell you more of the old god of which I spoke.
rows.quest:3520:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦26⟧. Perhaps now it is time to reveal more...
rows.quest:3520:completion:1: BThere is an ancient prophecy among the trolls, where the dead god Hakkar, the Soulflayer, will one day return to this earth. Some say the coming of Hakkar will bring joy and glory to trollkind, while others believe his resurrection marks the end of all things.
rows.quest:3520:completion:2: BI do not believe this myth, but I do know the essence of Hakkar holds great power, and this power should be kept from those who would abuse it...
rows.quest:4496:obj:0: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:4496:details:0: My research revealed to me that the silithid are like bees; destroy the queen of the hive, and the rest of should be thrown into disarray. I'll brew a lure that we'll use to bring out the queen; once summoned, you'll take her down.
rows.quest:4496:details:1: BFirst though, we need some reagents; we don't want you bungling into the jungle unprepared. Go west to find the silithid hive in ⟦E10⟧ and obtain a scent gland from one of the bugs. I'll also need some samples of the native Un'Goro soil.
rows.quest:4496:completion:0: The scent gland, ah yes. The membrane appears intact - excellent. The soil, yes, this should work out perfectly. With my special additions, I should be able to grind all this up into the perfect lure.
rows.quest:4496:completion:1: BGive me a moment to make the lure, ⟦27⟧. Once it's ready, we'll be able to enact the next step that may hopefully stop the silithid before they overrun Gadgetzan... and the rest of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4504:obj:0: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:4504:details:0: I'm always looking for a quick way to earn a gold, ⟦28⟧. If you help me with my newest idea, I'll let you in on a little of the profit. How does that sound to you?
rows.quest:4504:details:2: BHead to the tar pits in northern ⟦E10⟧, and collect me some tar. Not just any tar, now, you'll need to get it from the beasts that live around the tar pits. Regular tar just simply isn't sticky enough.
rows.quest:4504:details:3: BThe plant-like creatures contain chlorophyll in their skin, and mixed with the tar, it's super sticky!
rows.quest:4504:completion:0: Yes, this tar is just the stuff...
rows.quest:4504:completion:1: BHey, wait a minute, my hands... I can't seem to get them apart...
rows.quest:4504:completion:2: BMaybe this wasn't such a good idea. Oh, but wait! Super sticky tar remover! That's where the real money is!
rows.quest:4507:obj:0: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.
rows.quest:4507:obj:1: BBring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:4507:details:0: Here's the lure. Inside the hive network should be a crystal of some sort. We think the silithid use the crystal as some sort of hive-wide attunement device. As for where this crystal might be, I'd say try the hatcheries inside the hive.
rows.quest:4507:details:1: BUsing the lure on the crystal should roust out the queen, but be warned - she will probably be protected by several guards. Take out the queen and remove her brain. As icky as that sounds, we desperately need to study it. Good luck, ⟦29⟧!
rows.quest:4507:completion:0: Fantastic, ⟦30⟧! We've won quite the victory here today. It will take some time for us to fully understand what we have here; we'll put it to good use though, don't you worry about that.
rows.quest:4507:completion:1: BAs for the silithid, I genuinely doubt that this was the full extent of their presence. This is much too clean of a resolution, I'm sorry to say.
rows.quest:4508:obj:0: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Gracina Spiritmight in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:4508:details:0: My recent findings and the knowledge we have gained here today needs to reach hands that can quite possibly do something with it. As resourceful as we are here in Gadgetzan, we can't do this alone.
rows.quest:4508:details:1: BTake my latest report back to Gracina Spiritmight in ⟦E7⟧; she's still at the Temple of the Moon, is she not? She's got friends who are ⟦E5⟧ bigwigs; if we can get them involved in this ⟦31⟧, then we just might make it out of this alive.
rows.quest:4508:completion:0: While I genuinely appreciate this, I am not sure what good it will do us. The ⟦E5⟧ ignores threats from any source other than the ⟦E4⟧, and even our own leaders here in ⟦E7⟧ cannot agree on what exactly this threat is. Fools like Fandral Staghelm theorize that the silithid are nothing like the threat from the ancient past I claim them to be. His ignorance is only surpassed by his arrogance.
rows.quest:4508:completion:1: BYou have seen the threat yourself, ⟦32⟧. We must remain committed to defeating the silithid!
rows.quest:4509:obj:0: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Zilzibin Drumlore in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4509:details:0: My recent findings and the knowledge we have gained here today needs to reach hands that can quite possibly do something with it. As resourceful as we are here in Gadgetzan, we can't do this alone.
rows.quest:4509:details:1: BTake my latest report back to Zilzibin Drumlore in ⟦E1⟧; he's still in his place on the upper part of the Drag, is he not? He's got friends who are high within the ⟦E4⟧; if we can get them involved in this ⟦33⟧, then we just might make it out of this alive.
rows.quest:4509:completion:0: While I genuinely appreciate this, I am not sure what good it will do us. The ⟦E4⟧ ignores threats from any source other than the ⟦E5⟧. While Thrall himself might take action were the facts presented to him, he is beset on all sides by conflicting advice. These fools would have us chase our own imaginary tails were they to think it might catch the ⟦E5⟧ unawares!
rows.quest:4509:completion:1: BYou have seen the threat yourself, ⟦34⟧. We must remain committed to defeating the silithid!
rows.quest:5801:obj:0: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of ⟦E11⟧ Plume Ridge in ⟦E10⟧. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
rows.quest:5801:obj:1: BBring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:5801:details:0: You need two bars of thorium and a powerfully hot heat source to forge the key stem. You're on your own for the thorium, but I can help with the heat.
rows.quest:5801:details:1: BTo our west in ⟦E10⟧ is ⟦E11⟧ Plume Ridge - a simmering volcano. The lava lake up top is hot enough to fuse thorium and bone together. Your gold has bought you a mold that simply requires you to dip it in the lake up top; the lava will take care of the rest.
rows.quest:5801:details:2: BThat's it on my end. To finish your key, you'll need to talk to Arbington again.
rows.quest:5801:completion:0: We've got quite the costly skeleton key there, don't we ⟦35⟧? Still, it remains unfinished; the time has now come to put some focus behind our creation. To that end, you're going to have to face the ultimate foe we've been working towards facing in Andorhal... the being that runs the show within the ruined city walls.
rows.quest:5801:completion:1: BI'm speaking of Araj the Summoner - a lich, and one of the most powerful beings the Scourge calls as its own.
